notes.title: Update #4
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25993457/f1d3d03ea489fa94662b7469b8725a21d1555d24.png[/img]

Two new storms (levels) have been added.
Catastrophe and Vicious!

Chained Dragon now has an additional ability which reads:  At the start of each player's turn, Chained Dragon depletes that player of 2 gold.

Hoarding Dragon now has an additional ability which reads:  At the start of each player's turn, Hoarding Dragon drains that player of 1 aether.

Mind Bender's Empower ability now, in addition to granting 2 mana to all combatants in an are of two tiles, also increases their max mana by 1.

Serene Angel's Transcendent Victory ability has had its mana cost reduced from 15 to 12.

Serene Angel's now has an additional ability called Smile Upon.  Smile Upon, costs 0 mana, and reads as follows:
Select an allied combatant, it is granted 1 mana for each domain you have in play.  Serene Angel is stunned until end of turn.

Serene Angel now has an additional ability called Righteous Voice which reads:
A card with Righteous Voice will not be affected by Silencing Strike.

More updates coming soon.  Two more level and more balance changes are in development!

notes.notes:
Added Silencer ability "Persecute".  Costs 5 mana and reads; "Select a domain, Silencer begins silencing all cards requiring the selected domain until the end of your opponent's turn".

Added Abundant Harvest ability which reads; "At the start of your turn, you are granted 1 gold for each card being silenced by an allied combatant".

Grammar and text clean ups
added award for beating levels on casual!
added option to turn off controller vibration

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[h1]Gameplay[/h1] 
Goblin Looters, HP reduced by 15.
Arcane Domain, Research ability tier 3 requirement removed
Warlord, base damage increased by 15, Fury Stike increased by 5
Fissure has been unbanned
Gaia's Orchard has been remade.  It now gives you 3 gold at the start of your turn and at the end of your turn it converts all terrain tiles in an area of 2 from water to swamp, swamp to hill, hill to forest, forest to lush forest.
Chained Dragon, damage increased from 25 to 35.
Chained Dragon, starting/max mana has been reduced to 1.  Worship ability cost has been increased to 6 aether, grants the chained Dragon +45 damage and +60 health permanently. 
Hoarding Dragon, damage increased from 30 to 40.
Hoarding Dragon, starting/max mana has been reduced to 1.  Exalt ability cost has been increased to 15 gold, grants the Hoarding Dragon +45 damage and +60 health permanently. 
Devouring Dragon, damage increased from 30 to 40.
Devouring Dragon, starting/max mana has been reduced to 1.  Devour ability now requires of you to select 3 allied combatants which are slain, grants the Devouring Dragon +45 damage and +60 health permanently. 
The Dusk Carnival level has been made easier.  Goblin Looters will only be played on the pro difficulty.

[h1]Cosmetics[/h1] 
The replay mode's continue button, which is displayed after the match is over, has been remade.
The ambassador's poll has been slightly changed.
The Dame's Cultural Victory ability can be renamed.  This will not change gameplay in anyway.  
	By naming your deck to read "I'm different", Cultural Victory will be changed to read Politely End Conversation.
	By naming your deck to read "unrequited love", renames the ability back to Cultural Victory.


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1] 
A bug where a player's steam persona name would not be displayed during replays has been corrected
A bug where audio setting preferences do not automatically apply on game start has been corrected.
